🎨 OpusClip is the world's No.1 AI video agent, built for authenticity on social media.

We envision a world where everyone can authentically share their story through video, with no expertise needed. Within just 18 months of our launch, over 10 million creators and businesses have used OpusClip to enhance their social presence.

We have raised $50 million in total funding and are fortunate to have some of the most supportive investors, including SoftBank Vision Fund, DCM Ventures, Millennium New Horizons, Fellows Fund, AI Grant, Jason Lemkin (SaaStr), Samsung Next, GTMfund, Alumni Ventures, and many more.

Obsess over customers

Be a part of this exciting journey with us!

The Role

OpusClip is building the next generation of AI-native products, and honestly, we need someone who can keep up. We're looking for a Full-Stack AI Engineer who lives at the intersection of applied AI, product instinct, and solid architecture. If you're the type who waits around for a ticket to land in your queue, this isn't it. We need a builder who's genuinely energized by zero-to-one chaos, brings real technical judgment to AI-generated code, and has the grit to ship stuff nobody's seen before.

What We're Looking For

•
You've worked on AI-native codebases before (product or engineering background, doesn't matter) and you know how to bring order to the chaos.

•
Equally comfortable on React up front and Node.js or Django in the back. You don't sit around waiting for someone else to own a layer.

•
You've shipped something from scratch, ideally solo or on a tiny team. You define your own scope and actually like ambiguity.

•
You've got that combat spirit — speed is everything, and shipping feels like a sport to you. (If you've seen the F1 movie, you already get it.)

•
You use Cursor and other AI coding tools fluently, but you also know exactly where their limits are and when it's time for human judgment to take over.

Nice to Haves

•
Multimodal AI engineering (video ML / video AI)

•
A background that blends product thinking with technical depth

Tech Stack

GCP · TypeScript · Python · React · Node.js · Redis · MongoDB · Cloud Storage · LLMs · AI Agents

EEO

OpusClip is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. OpusClip considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Opus Clip is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for an AI Artist to help define the next generation of AI-powered video creation at OpusClip. You'll work at the intersection of visual design, generative AI, storytelling, and workflow innovation—elevating AI-generated content from impressive to exceptional.

You have exceptional creative taste and a deep understanding of generative AI. You don't just generate assets—you refine, direct, and elevate them until every frame meets your standards.

You are naturally curious, constantly exploring new tools and techniques, and you enjoy building systems that turn creative intuition into scalable workflows.

Responsibilities

•
Partner closely with the AI team to improve the quality, consistency, and creative direction of AI-generated video content.

•
Develop prompting frameworks and generation workflows that consistently produce high-quality outputs at scale.

•
Create repeatable creative systems that capture and operationalize visual taste, design principles, and storytelling best practices.

•
Evaluate and refine AI-generated assets, identifying and correcting issues related to composition, motion, continuity, realism, and visual quality.

•
Experiment with emerging AI creative tools and technologies, translating new capabilities into compelling product and content experiences.

•
Collaborate across product, design, marketing, and AI teams to help shape the future of AI video creation.

Qualifications

•
Strong hands-on experience with generative AI tools for image, video, or creative content generation.

•
Excellent visual design, motion design, or creative direction instincts with a high standard for quality and detail.

•
Deep understanding of prompt engineering, creative workflows, and AI generation techniques.

•
Strong storytelling instincts with an understanding of pacing, narrative structure, and visual communication.

•
Ability to create scalable frameworks and processes rather than relying solely on one-off creative execution.

•
Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with rapidly evolving tools and workflows.

What Makes You Successful

•
You can quickly spot visual inconsistencies, quality issues, and creative opportunities that others miss.

•
You understand both the capabilities and limitations of today's AI models and know how to consistently push them further.

•
You naturally think in systems, workflows, and reusable frameworks that help teams scale creative output.

•
You combine artistic judgment with technical curiosity, constantly testing new tools and approaches.

•
You care deeply about the final product and are willing to iterate until the work reaches a high creative standard.

Nice to Have

•
Background in product design, visual design, motion graphics, creative technology, or related fields.

•
Experience building node-based workflows in ComfyUI, Fal, or similar AI infrastructure tools.

•
Previous experience in video production, film, advertising, gaming, or other creative industries.

The Details

•
Location: On-site in Mountain View, CA

•
Competitive salary, equity, and performance-based bonuses

•
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

•
Opportunity to help shape one of the fastest-moving categories in AI

You Should Not Apply If

•
You rarely review or critique your own AI-generated work for quality and consistency.

•
You view prompting as the entire job rather than one part of a larger creative process.

•
You prefer receiving fully defined briefs instead of building new systems and workflows from scratch.

•
You are not genuinely excited about the future of AI-generated video and creative tooling.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to own and shape core product experiences at OpusClip. This is a role for a hands-on builder who can turn complex AI capabilities into intuitive, polished, and useful experiences, and drive the work from early exploration through launch and iteration.

You won’t just receive requirements and turn them into screens. You’ll help define the problems we solve, challenge assumptions, establish the product direction, and work closely with product and engineering to ship high-quality experiences quickly. You should be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve, technology is constantly changing, and designers are expected to bring clarity and momentum.

We’re looking for an AI-native designer who actively uses AI throughout the design and development process. You’ll use AI tools and vibe-coding workflows to explore ideas, build functional prototypes, test interactions, and communicate solutions more effectively. A working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Git will help you collaborate directly with engineers and make small front-end improvements when needed.

This role requires strong product thinking, excellent visual and interaction design skills, curiosity, organization, and a high level of personal responsibility. You’ll be expected to identify opportunities, make thoughtful decisions, and move projects forward without waiting for detailed direction.

What You'll Do

•
Own product design end-to-end, from problem framing and user flows to polished, production-ready UI across our web and product surfaces.

•
Drive projects from concept to shipped: scope the work, set priorities, and move without waiting for direction.

•
Partner closely with product managers, engineers, AI researchers, and other stakeholders to define product direction, requirements, and priorities.

•
Go beyond executing requirements by identifying user problems, questioning assumptions, and proposing better product solutions.

•
Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity interfaces, interaction patterns, and detailed implementation specifications.

•
Get hands-on with the front end when it helps, use your working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Git to prototype, ship small fixes, and collaborate tightly with engineers instead of throwing designs over the wall.

•
Set and maintain design consistency, contributing to the systems and guidelines that hold as we scale.

•
Leverage AI tools to accelerate ideation, production, and iteration without compromising quality.

What We're Looking For

•
A strong track record in product design, with a portfolio of live, shipped work, not just concepts.

•
A genuine self-starter who thrives with autonomy, examples of projects you scoped, drove, and shipped largely on your own, with minimal direction.

•
Expert-level proficiency in Figma and modern design tooling, with an exceptional sense of layout, typography, interaction, and product thinking.

•
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Git, comfortable prototyping in code, jumping in to fast-fix small front-end issues, and speaking the same language as engineers.

•
Fluency with AI creative and prototyping tools, and a point of view on how to use them (including vibe coding) to work faster and better.

•
Responsible, organized, and curious. You own your outcomes, keep your work structured, and stay hungry to learn and explore.

•
The judgment to balance craft with business goals and user needs.

•
Excellent communication and the ability to align design, product, and engineering as a partner and a leader.

•
Bonus: experience with animation or motion design tools (e.g., Rive, After Effects).

Why Join Us

•
Shape the brand of a fast-moving, globally recognized AI company at a pivotal moment.

•
Real creative ownership and the autonomy to lead — this is your workstream to define and drive.

About the Role

OpusClip is looking for a staff-level, product-oriented Data Science leader to build an effective and increasingly AI-native data function.

You will set priorities for a small Data team, personally lead our hardest analytical problems, improve how we measure product and business performance, and build systems that help teams make better decisions with less manual analytical work.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You may lead through direct management or technical leadership; formal people management is not required. We care more about your ability to lead through judgment, technical depth, and example.

You will work closely with Product, Growth, Finance, Engineering, and AI across product analytics, experimentation, user intelligence, data quality, growth measurement, AI data flywheels, and agentic analytics.

This expands the existing role from owning trusted metrics and analyses into setting direction and creating leverage across the Data function.

What You’ll Do

Lead the Data function

•
Set priorities for a small Data team and focus limited capacity on the highest-impact problems.

•
Personally lead ambiguous or high-stakes analytical projects.

•
Raise standards for metrics, experimentation, analytical quality, and decision-making.

•
Lead and develop Data Scientists, analysts, and Data Engineers through technical direction and example.

•
Reduce repetitive and reactive work by turning recurring problems into reusable systems and processes.

Drive product and business decisions

•
Analyze activation, retention, segmentation, monetization, user behavior, and lifetime value.

•
Translate ambiguous business questions into rigorous analysis and clear recommendations.

•
Identify opportunities where Data can directly improve key company metrics.

•
Build stronger user profiling and segmentation to inform product strategy, operations, and company goal setting.

•
Improve experimentation and causal measurement across Product and Growth.

The existing JD already emphasizes turning product and customer data into business decisions; this role owns that mandate at a broader level.

Improve data quality and measurement

•
Establish trusted definitions and validation for critical product and business metrics.

•
Identify systematic issues across tracking, pipelines, transformations, tables, and dashboards.

•
Partner with Data Engineering and Engineering to prevent recurring data problems rather than repeatedly fixing symptoms.

•
Build reusable datasets, metric definitions, monitoring, and analytical frameworks that improve self-service.

You do not need to be a data infrastructure expert, but you should be technically strong enough to diagnose how data moves through a system, identify systemic failure modes, and work effectively with engineers to fix them.

Build Growth intelligence

•
Help Growth understand acquisition quality, retention, LTV, and the true value of different channels and customer segments.

•
Improve performance marketing measurement beyond surface-level attribution toward experimentation and incrementality.

•
Identify opportunities to improve CAC, conversion, retention, monetization, or other major business metrics.

•
Build horizontal analytical tools and frameworks that enable Growth and Product teams to run better experiments and make faster decisions.

Partner with our AI teams

•
Support data curation, evaluation design, experimentation, and measurement for AI-powered product experiences.

•
Identify product behavior that can become useful evaluation data, feedback signals, or failure cases.

•
Connect AI quality with real user behavior and business outcomes.

•
Strengthen the loop from product usage → data → AI improvement → better product.

Model training experience is not required. The existing role already includes AI evaluation, curation, and online/offline measurement; this senior role is expected to make that collaboration systematic.

Build AI-native analytics

•
Use AI to automate recurring analytical work and improve the productivity of the Data team.

•
Build trusted self-service tools for Product and business teams.

•
Explore agentic systems that can detect unusual metric movements, identify contributing segments, generate hypotheses, and investigate likely causes.

•
Help move the company from dashboards and one-off analysis toward proactive business intelligence.

What We’re Looking For

•
Significant experience in data science, product analytics, decision science, or a closely related field.

•
Demonstrated Staff, Principal, Lead, or equivalent scope, regardless of formal title.

•
Strong product and business judgment. You identify important questions instead of waiting for them to be assigned.

•
Strong SQL and Python skills and a willingness to remain hands-on.

•
Deep experience with product metrics, retention, segmentation, monetization, or experimentation.

•
Strong understanding of statistics, A/B testing, and causal reasoning.

•
Strong data-quality instincts and enough data-engineering knowledge to diagnose systemic pipeline problems.

•
Ability to turn one-off analyses into reusable tools, frameworks, datasets, or processes.

•
Ability to lead through influence, technical credibility, and clear communication.

•
Strong ownership and effectiveness in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

•
Growth analytics, incrementality, LTV, attribution, or causal inference experience.

•
Experience working with AI/ML teams on evaluation or data curation.

•
Experience building AI-assisted or agentic analytics systems.

•
Data engineering experience with pipelines, transformations, backfills, or automated validation.

•
Experience building user segmentation or behavioral profiling systems.

•
Experience in SaaS, consumer software, creator products, subscription businesses, or AI products.

•
Familiarity with BigQuery, Mixpanel, Statsig, Superset, Prefect, Airflow, dbt, or similar tools.

Deep data infrastructure expertise and model-training experience are not required.

What Success Looks Like

Good success — Build an effective Data Science function for an AI product

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have:

•
Systematically improved our data practices across metric quality, experimentation, data validation, and analytical workflows.

•
